stem: Which factor links all of these modern innovations?

options.label: F
options.text: They are all products initially created for use in the U.S. communications industry.

options.label: G
options.text: They each include material that was first grown on U.S. experimental farms in the late nineteenth century.

options.label: H
options.text: They each include technology that was originally developed for use in the U.S. space exploration program.

options.label: J
options.text: They are all special tools first created for U.S. transportation workers in the early twentieth century.
